build_transformer_model: build a TransformerModel encoder-decoder instance using build_model with args and task
build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder with source dictionary and token embeddings for encoding input sequences
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder with target dictionary and embeddings for autoregressive sequence generation
run_transformer_forward: run the forward pass of TransformerModel with source tokens and previous output tokens
register_transformer_architecture: register a new transformer architecture variant like transformer_wmt_en_de with custom hyperparameters
